unit: Mt wet (~80% moisture); ~1.2 Mt dry matter
main_regions_current: Same as starch factories; largest cluster Tay Ninh
main_regions_former: Tay Ninh; Gia Lai; Dak Lak; Kon Tum; Binh Phuoc; Son La
n_sites_or_key_companies: All starch factories (~120-150); example Dinh Khue (Tay Ninh) 280 t roots/day
current_use: Wet sale to cattle/pig farms; sun- or drum-dried and sold to feed mills (e.g. Son La to former Ha Nam and Bac Giang mills); pellets; biogas; fertiliser
seasonality: Produced Nov to May with the campaign; self-ensiles in pits (pH 3.2-3.5) and stores for years with small losses (Laos study)
notes: DERIVED: 2.49 Mt starch (11M exports 2.28 Mt x 12/11) x 2.5 t wet pulp per t starch (Thai ratio; 4.4 t roots per t starch) = 6.2 Mt wet = 0.57 t wet or 0.12 t DM per t root. 2024 equivalent ~3.7 Mt wet (lower starch exports). Ignores domestic starch use (would raise) and re-exported imported starch (would lower). Composition (DM): starch about 54-70%, cellulose 5-25%, CP 1.55-2.6% (FS-18). Implied price = Dinh Khue 6 bn VND revenue / 3,500 t pulp (Dec 2024). Old quote (2005): wet 200, dry 800-1,000 VND/kg. No current published pulp price found.
